subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: For malformed workspace SKILL.md files, is a dedicated `skills lint` diagnostic command enough to close this issue, or must normal `skills list`/`skills check`/status/Web surfaces also show skipped-candidate warnings?
rationale: The source-backed problem remains valid and an open PR owns a narrow implementation, but the issue's requested behavior spans CLI list/check, Web UI, validation, and docs; automation cannot safely choose that product scope.

options.title: Accept lint plus status first
options.body: Review and land the open PR or a replacement that exposes skipped-load diagnostics in core CLI/status, then track Web UI surfacing separately if still desired.

options.title: Require full visible diagnostics
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella until malformed-skill diagnostics are visible in normal CLI/status and Web UI flows, not only a separate lint command.

options.title: Narrow to CLI lint only
options.body: Make the issue's completion criterion the documented lint/validate command and explicitly leave list/check/Web warnings out of scope.

recommendation.title: Accept lint plus status first
recommendation.body: Review and land the open PR or a replacement that exposes skipped-load diagnostics in core CLI/status, then track Web UI surfacing separately if still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: They have strong history across the skills CLI/docs and frontmatter parser surfaces and previously made the related implemented-on-main call for the narrower colon-frontmatter report.
